stops.note: to fix, to fasten, combined with prae- (before)
to fasten before, to attach in front, from prae- and figere
stops.meaning: to fasten before, to attach in front

stops.note: settled as the English word for letters added to the beginning of a word
stops.meaning: letters or a syllable added to the beginning of a word

current_meaning: a letter or group of letters added to the beginning of a word to change its meaning
